description.narrative: Lok Foundation is seeking a Capacity Development (CD) grant that will be used for TA projects with portfolio companies of their equity funds Lok Capital II (until exiting) and Capital Lok III (expected to close before end 2015). TA projects will focus on improvements of operations, governance and social / bottom of the pyramid (BoP) missions of portfolio companies.
